title: Retreat and Foresight: pick the destination on the map
description: Naalu's Foresight and every retreat prompt (combat retreat, Skilled Retreat, Ral Nel commander retreat, and the announce question) now name the ships and the system they leave in the heading and take the destination on the map like a tactical move: the system the ships leave is marked FROM, the legal destinations are highlighted, a click selects one, Confirm sends it; the chip list is the fallback. Desktop and 390x844. Synthetic board through a mocked server; the choices (prompts, subtypes, ids, labels, payloads) are copied from the engine.

shots.heading: Naalu Foresight (desktop)
shots.caption: Before: Foresight: 'move your ships from 18 to 26' x3 as radio rows in a dialog that hides the map; the origin only appears inside every label. After: Heading: ships and origin. The origin is marked FROM (amber) on the map, the systems Naalu can move to are highlighted; tap one (or its chip) and confirm. Each chip says what the engine knows about that system.

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cd web && npm run build:wasm && rm -rf node_modules/.vite && npm run screenshots -- GB. The before/ PNGs were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on commit 80ce1bf1 (scene.ts and capture-1-scenes.ts copied there).

notes.title: Not on the map
notes.text: The Ral Nel commander's second step (which ship goes, 'retreat which ship now?') names no destination and stays a list; stay-or-retreat is a yes/no question.
